movie.title: The Journey to Gyeong-ju
movie.overview: Eight years ago, the youngest daughter, Gyeong-ju, disappeared during a school field trip to Gyeongju and never came home alive.  On what would have been her birthday, her mother Ok-sil and her three daughters—Jang-ju, Young-ju, and Dong-ju—put on matching family T-shirts and set off for Gyeongju, the place where Gyeong-ju vanished, in what appears to be a family trip to honor her memory. But beneath the cheerful façade lies a deadly secret. In the trunk of their van is a bound and unconscious man zipped inside a plastic bag.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Years after her youngest daughter's fatal disappearance, a grieving mother and her three remaining daughters embark on a seemingly nostalgic family trip to Gyeongju while hiding a kidnapped man in their trunk.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Eight years after the youngest daughter, Gyeong-ju, went missing and died during a school trip, her mother Ok-sil and three sisters travel to Gyeongju in matching outfits under the guise of a memorial journey. However, the seemingly peaceful family outing masks a dark, calculated mission for retribution. Stashed inside the trunk of their van is a bound, unconscious man tied to the past tragedy. As they near their destination, the secret unravels, turning their tribute into a tense, unraveling crime dynamic.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The memory of Gyeong-ju, who vanished and lost her life during a school field trip eight years prior, continues to haunt her surviving family members. On what would have been the missing girl's birthday, mother Ok-sil gathers her three older daughters—Jang-ju, Young-ju, and Dong-ju—for a road trip to the city of Gyeongju. Dressed in cheerful, matching family T-shirts, the women present the image of a close-knit household seeking closure and honoring a tragic loss. Beneath this supportive exterior, however, the trip is driven by a far darker motivation than simple mourning. Secured within the trunk of their family van lies a plastic bag containing a bound and unconscious man closely connected to Gyeong-ju's fate. As the van travels toward the site of the original horror, internal family tensions flare while they manage the logistics of their dangerous cargo. Each daughter grapples with the weight of grief, complicity, and the moral boundaries of maternal vengeance. The journey forces the women to confront both the unresolved trauma of losing Gyeong-ju and the irreversible consequences of taking justice into their own hands.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: On the birthday of her late youngest daughter, Gyeong-ju—who vanished and was found dead during a school field trip eight years earlier—Ok-sil gathers her remaining three daughters, Jang-ju, Young-ju, and Dong-ju, for a road trip to Gyeongju. Outwardly, the women appear to be on a synchronized family memorial journey, wearing matching T-shirts to mark the bittersweet occasion. However, the trip takes a dark turn as it is revealed they are transporting a bound, unconscious man concealed in their van's trunk, setting off a high-stakes dynamic driven by revenge, secret grief, and domestic strain.
